articles.title: Trump’s Greenland Threats Reopen Tariff Wounds in Europe
articles.mainIdea: Trump’s Greenland Threats Reopen Tariff Wounds in Europe
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Trump’s Greenland Threats Reopen Tariff Wounds in Europe. Trump announced a 10% tariff, rising to 25% in June, on eight European nations, including Denmark, for saying they would undertake token NATO military exercises in Greenland in response to US saber-rattling. While the tariffs aren’t certain to take effect, the threat was a brazen escalation and insult to close US allies, trampling over the US-EU trade deal reached only six months earlier at Trump’s Turnberry resort in Scotland.
